title: Microsoft 365 admin center: more agent metadata fields in the inventory export
summary: Hold: the documented Graph reporting API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence, but the briefing omits that requirement beside its licensing and automation guidance. The roadmap facts and export navigation are supported; the uncertainty about the new export columns is appropriately stated.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; changes
claims.claim: The registry page does not name the five roadmap fields as export columns.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 admin center inventory export metadata Capabilities Data Sources Actions Created In Created By columns; opened agent-registry-overview in full. Its export list names twelve other columns, not these five.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the new fields appear by default or require selection, so the default state is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 agent registry Export export permission role AI Reader export columns default customize view disable export; read roadmap record and agent-registry-overview. Neither states the new fields' default inclusion.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Viewing all agents requires no specific licence, only an appropriate role such as AI Reader or AI Administrator.
claims.quote: Viewing all agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center doesn't require a specific license. Administrators only need the appropriate role, such as AI Reader (recommended least-privilege role) or AI Administrator, to access the inventory view.

claims.claim: The agent management overview lists a required subscription and licences for Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot or Microsoft Agent 365 as a prerequisite.
claims.quote: Your organization has the required subscription and licenses for either Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, or Microsoft Agent 365.

claims.claim: The inventory feature's licensing model is included rather than an independently published export entitlement.
claims.quote: The following licensing options include agents that can be managed in Microsoft 365 admin center: Microsoft 365 plans ... Microsoft Copilot ... Microsoft Agent 365.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The registry page publishes no export-specific licence requirement.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Agent 365 agent registry inventory export licensing price meter charge Package Management API license; read agent-registry-overview and agent-365-overview. The registry page has no export-specific licence requirement.

claims.claim: The registry pages publish no separate charge or meter for the UI export.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Agent 365 agent registry inventory export licensing price meter charge Package Management API license; read registry, management, convergence and Agent 365 service-description pages. No UI-export charge or meter is stated.

claims.claim: A licence or rate specific to the five new export fields is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: agent registry export metadata Capabilities Data Sources Actions Created In Created By default columns Customize view enable export role license charge Microsoft 365; read registry, management, convergence and service-description pages. No field-specific licence or rate is stated.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft does not document whether the roadmap's Data Sources and Actions export fields contain data itself or only its type.
claims.quote: Searched: agent registry export Data Sources Actions metadata fields content type export columns select enable disable; read registry page and agent-details search excerpt. The latter describes Data & tools metadata, not these export fields' contents.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The export produces a report of agent metadata rather than performing an agent governance action.
claims.quote: Exports agents to a CSV file. ... You can export the list of agents to an Excel file. Set the export scope to All agents or Filtered agents for analysis and reporting.

claims.claim: Customize view selects the columns displayed on the All agents page.
claims.quote: You can customize the agent list on the All agents page. Choose which columns to display.

claims.claim: Learn does not say Customize view choices carry into the export.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 agent registry Export export permission role AI Reader export columns default customize view disable export; read registry Customize view and Export to Excel sections. No relationship between displayed and exported column selections is stated.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no admin setting that turns this registry export on or off.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 agent registry Export export permission role AI Reader export columns default customize view disable export; read registry page. Search results document an export toggle for Viva's Agent Dashboard, not the registry inventory export.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no admin setting for selecting this registry export's columns.
claims.quote: Searched: agent registry export Data Sources Actions metadata fields content type export columns select enable disable; read registry page. It says items can be included, but documents no export column-selection setting; Customize view governs the displayed list.

claims.where: controls[0].api; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: GET /v1.0/copilot/admin/catalog/packages is presented as the reporting alternative without its required Microsoft Agent 365 licence qualification.
claims.quote: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 license. ... GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/copilot/admin/catalog/packages
claims.fix: Keep the documented call. Append to controls[0].note and the Graph paragraph: 'Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence.' Add to Cost and licensing: 'The Graph reporting alternative requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence, per the List packages reference; this is distinct from viewing the inventory.' The cited reference already supports these additions.

claims.claim: The List packages reference also prints a beta request.
claims.quote: GET https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages

claims.claim: The registry page describes its Microsoft Graph agent endpoints as preview.
claims.quote: By using the new Microsoft Graph API endpoints, now in preview, administrators can integrate the following tasks into existing workflows across agents in Microsoft 365

claims.claim: The registry page says the API works with the AI Administrator role.
claims.quote: The API works with the AI Admin Role.

claims.claim: The List packages reference does not confirm that its response carries the five roadmap export fields.
claims.quote: Searched: List packages fetched reference text for capabilit, createdBy, createdIn, dataSource, action and created; none matched. Read request and response sections: the response is a copilotPackage collection and examples may be shortened.

claims.claim: The Graph operation returns a list of packages containing agents, not the UI export file.
claims.quote: By default, the response contains only titles that contain an agent. ... If successful, this method returns a 200 OK response code and a collection of copilotPackage objects in the response body.

claims.claim: The checklist asks administrators to take stock of registry-viewing role assignments, but no control row covers those assignments.
claims.quote: Confirm which of your administrators hold the roles ... able to view agent registry information ...; the only control row is 'Exporting the agent inventory, with its metadata fields'.
claims.fix: Replace that checklist bullet with 'Name who is responsible for running the export.' This removes the role-assignment inventory step that has no control row, without adding an unverified row.
